race.description: Jr Richards & Sons Class 1 & Mdn Plate
race.comment: LITLFELA (7) failed to figure again last time over 1400m at Bathurst, beaten 2.25 lengths into fifth. Gets 2kg off from the low draw and should be better suited getting back out to 1600m. Ticks a few boxes and can play a leading role. SNOW DOG (4) disappointed last time when seventh over 2000m at Louth after a close second at Gilgandra the run prior. Better suited at this shorter trip so should be involved in the finish. REGALADE (9) ran below expectations last start, finishing seventh and beaten 4 lengths at Forbes over 1300m. Should be thereabouts in this more suitable race. OUR DANDI ANGEL (6) looks a nice mare on the rise, missing last time out at Nowra but turning in a good figure. Has plenty of upside.
